title: AI & Data Graduate Programme FY28
location: Dublin, Ireland; client/office attendance 1-5 days weekly
description:
Full employer JD and live application form read in browser 12 September 2026. Permanent full-time Strategy & Consulting Ireland role, Dublin, EUR40,000/year. Deadline25 October2026. Starts September2027-Spring2028; applicants must have bachelor results before starting.

Graduate client work spans AI strategy and delivery, business process improvement, commercial use cases, AI adoption and data-science insights. Familiarity with any relevant combination of GenAI/agentic AI, cloud platforms, Python/R or other data languages, ML, SQL/ETL/NoSQL/warehousing, and BI tools is sought; all technical areas are explicitly not expected. Structured thinking, business curiosity, communication, adaptability, initiative, creativity and team/leadership examples matter. Minimum2.1 degree obtained/predicted; final-year/recent-graduate eligibility. Application asks for minimum level8 honours bachelor/equivalent, qualification details and extracurricular examples.

Commutable to Dublin; minimum1-2 office/client days, up to5 and travel inside/outside Ireland depending assignment. Application asks about full-time Irish work rights and supporting document.

IMPORTANT: The form states AI-assisted applications may be withdrawn and asks candidates to avoid AI use. Saved as a manual candidate-writing option only; no AI-authored application/resume released. Nothing entered or submitted.
